per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I could not find a public dataset with a verified landing page or DOI that records per-floret centre coordinates or parastichy crossing angles for sunflower capitula. A search of the open portals found only related items. Swinton's arXiv paper 2407.05857 (Disk-stacking models are consistent with Fibonacci and non-Fibonacci structure in sunflowers) refers to a large dataset of seedheads, but its arXiv page gives no repository, no dataset DOI and no URL, and it describes parastichy counts rather than coordinates or angles. Parastichy counts alone cannot decide a test about crossing angles. The capitulum-inclination record on data.gov is about head tilt, not floret positions. Naming any of these as the dataset would misrepresent it, and I will not guess at a supplement from memory. The test needs a new set of sunflower head images with floret centres extracted, or a published coordinate set that I have not verified.

per_claim.no_dataset_reason: I could not verify a specific public repository record of 3D red blood cell surfaces, with and without hypotonic treatment, under a URL or DOI I am sure resolves. Searches turned up a 3D confocal RBC study (Simionato et al., 825 cells), but no verifiable repository landing page, and the Zenodo RBC records found were 2D image datasets, which cannot give a surface mean curvature. I am leaving the dataset null rather than risk an invented identifier.
